text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hrraaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And Inari One crosses the finish! Inari
One
emerges victorious in this nail-biting
race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
What a race! This Mainichi Okan is
gonna go
down in history, no doubt
about it!

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
And this is partly thanks to Inari One! In
this age
where Oguri Cap and the others
shine so brightly,
you're exactly what we
need!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Inari's unbelievable! To think she'd be
able to do
so well against the best
runners in her generation!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I won... I beat Oguri!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(But yikes... My legs won't stop
shakin'...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(This never happened before. Oguri's
runnin' was
so powerful and suffocatin',
it almost feels like
she's still chasin' me
down...)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I lost today. But I won't next time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Expect me at the autumn Tenno Sho. I'll
beat you
there, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Come on, Inari! She just threw down a
challenge!
I gotta say somethin' snappy!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Challenge accepted. But don't get
cocky... 'cause
no matter what you do,
I'm still gonna win.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sure. I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Bye.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Damn it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I'm so pathetic! I'm tremblin' all over
again! This
is no way for a winner to act!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(And it's not just Oguri who's gonna be
at the
autumn Tenno Sho—Creek'll be
runnin' in it too.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: The way I am now... there's no way...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(No, I can't think like that! Once I start
goin'
down that spiral, there's no comin'
back!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What am I worryin' for?! All I gotta do is
train
more 'n' win, just like I did today!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's it... That's all I gotta do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the racecourse with Inari One, I
can't
help but notice the hard look on
her face despite
the fact that she won
today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I rack my brain, trying to come up with
the right
words to say...

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One was incredible! I didn't think
she had it
in her to beat Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
I guess they're kinda similar. They both
got too
good for regional races and had
to come out
here. They grew too big for
their little ponds.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
But... it's also pretty hard to get noticed
in the
regionals. They must be putting in
a lot of extra
work to grab people's
attention.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Exactly. Seeing Inari One today convinced me it would've been a waste for her to stay in the regionals. That's why she's in the centrals!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya got it all wrong! That's not why I'm
here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have a feeling it'd be best to get Inari
away from
everyone as quickly as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Right, sorry. Let's get goin'.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One applies herself passionately to
training
for the autumn Tenno Sho, but I
keep catching
glimpses of a pained
expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whazza matter, Boss? You all right?
Could scare
the clouds away with that
face you're makin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whazza matter, Boss? You all right?
Could scare
the clouds away with that
face you're makin'!
choice_data_list: ...Are you doing all right yourself, Inari?
...Are you doing all right yourself, Inari?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
'Course I am! No need to worry 'bout me!
Sure,
I've been a bit down 'cause the
weather's been all
gloomy lately, but
that's all!
choice_data_list: ...Are you doing all right yourself, Inari?
...Are you doing all right yourself, Inari?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I realized somethin'.
I'm
nowhere good enough to win the
autumn Tenno
Sho right now!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Creek's gonna be there too, not just
Oguri! That
means I gotta put the pedal
to the metal 'n' train
like hell!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Creek's gonna be there too, not just
Oguri! That
means I gotta put the pedal
to the metal 'n' train
like hell!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seems like I'll have to keep a close eye
on her. I
might have to intervene if it
comes down to it, to
ensure her own
safety.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her trainer and faithful partner in all
this, I
have to be ready.
choice_data_list: (Even if that isn't what she truly wants...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(This is bad. Even Boss's worryin' about
me now...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(This is bad. Even Boss's worryin' about
me now...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I'm feelin' all sortsa antsy lately,
though. I can't
even focus in trainin'... I
gotta get my head on
straight, pronto.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(The others must be dead focused on
trainin'.
They're probably workin' way
harder than me,
workin' at levels leagues
above my own!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (But me...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (My runnin's nowhere near good enough to really show off how incredible the people of Oi are.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(If I can't become Umamusume of the
Year, my
performance on the track 'n'
the claims I made'll
be for nothing!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(The stakes're so high, but there's no
way I can
beat Oguri and Creek right
now.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(At this rate, I won't be able to answer
everyone's
hopes...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! I know I gotta eat, but my
appetite's busted.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Damn it all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho looms in the
distance, and
it won't be long at all until
it's upon us.
